cell.label: Suspected phimosis—foreskin does not retract over glans.
Signs of inflammation or infection of glans or prepuce?
Age ≥15 years, signs of scarring at prepuce, or painful erections?
Consider trial of medium-potency topical steroid such as betamethasone 0.05% cream or mometasone 0.1% cream twice a day for 4 wk.
Follow yearly for recurrence with physical exam.
Re-evaluate yearly. Consider repeat course of topical steroid. If evidence of scarring, recurrent infection, or pain, refer for possible surgical intervention.
